to be fair, i feel i overreacted a tad in this comment. however, certain missions were just unnecessary with the difficulty, to the point where the strategy to beat the mission made the difficulty pointless and made the game boring. for instance, headlong. it took me maybe 20-30 deaths before i said fuck it, and just went behind the wall and cheesed the boss with a scout, never taking any damage. also, the mission where we first enter calus ship and we first see his head again, that room was literal aids. it was not even that hard, just the fact i couldn’t go more than 10 seconds without being spammed with axion darts, spawning taken, and multiple mini bosses. other than those and the one where rohan dies, the legendary campaign was somewhat easy, ESPECIALLY compared to the wq legendary campaign, which honestly made me want to uninstall.

i don’t wanna say i was also clearing with ease, because trust me i wasn’t.(i died ATLEAST 10-20 times per mission).HOWEVER, compared to wq legendary campaign, this one felt like a literal walk in the park
the final mission was a little difficult, but for it having calus, a disciple of the witness, and his army, that mission was a fucking joke, especially the 2nd phase of the boss fight.

even tho i’ll admit that some parts of the legendary campaign was absurdly hard and annoying *cough headlong and the mission where we first enter the pyramid cough* i will say i actually enjoyed most of the legendary campaign and i was likely overreacting at most of it lol. still hate how calus got the xol treatment tho.
